html:
G'oya

Har bir bosqich oldingisiga bog'liq, shuning uchun ularni zanjir qilib hisoblaymiz. a har nomzodning ariza kunini topadi. s arizadan keyingi (yoki o'sha kungi) eng birinchi screen ni, i screen dan keyingi birinchi interview ni, o interview dan keyingi birinchi offer ni. Har qadamda JOIN oldingi bosqichga yetmaganlarni o'zi tashlab yuboradi. Ketgan kunlar shu ikki sananing ayirmasi.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH a AS (
  SELECT candidate_id, MIN(happened_on) AS t
  FROM events
  WHERE stage = 'applied'
  GROUP BY candidate_id
),
s AS (
  SELECT a.candidate_id, MIN(e.happened_on) AS t, MIN(e.happened_on) - a.t AS d
  FROM a
  JOIN events e ON e.candidate_id = a.candidate_id AND e.stage = 'screen' AND e.happened_on >= a.t
  GROUP BY a.candidate_id, a.t
),
i AS (
  SELECT s.candidate_id, MIN(e.happened_on) AS t, MIN(e.happened_on) - s.t AS d
  FROM s
  JOIN events e ON e.candidate_id = s.candidate_id AND e.stage = 'interview' AND e.happened_on >= s.t
  GROUP BY s.candidate_id, s.t
),
o AS (
  SELECT i.candidate_id, MIN(e.happened_on) AS t, MIN(e.happened_on) - i.t AS d
  FROM i
  JOIN events e ON e.candidate_id = i.candidate_id AND e.stage = 'offer' AND e.happened_on >= i.t
  GROUP BY i.candidate_id, i.t
),
steps AS (
  SELECT 1 AS pos, 'applied' AS stage, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a) AS candidates, CAST(NULL AS NUMERIC) AS avg_days
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'screen', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s), (SELECT ROUND(AVG(d), 1) FROM s)
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'interview', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM i), (SELECT ROUND(AVG(d), 1) FROM i)
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'offer', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o), (SELECT ROUND(AVG(d), 1) FROM o)
)
SELECT stage, candidates, avg_days
FROM steps
ORDER BY pos

To'rtta qator UNION ALL bilan qo'lda yig'iladi: hech kim yetmagan bosqich ham 0 va NULL bilan chiqadi, AVG bo'sh to'plamda o'zi NULL beradi. Namunada 3-nomzodning suhbati arizadan oldin bo'lgan va hisobga kirmaydi, shuning uchun uning intervyusi ham sanalmaydi. 5-nomzodga intervyusiz taklif berilgan, u offer ga yetmagan.

Tuzoqlar

Vaqt tartibini tekshirmaslik eng ko'p uchraydigan xato: unda 3-nomzodning arizadan oldingi suhbati ham sanaladi. Har bosqichning birinchi hodisasini alohida olib, keyin solishtirish ham yetmaydi. Nomzod 1-aprelda intervyuda bo'lgan, 2-aprelda ariza bergan, 4-aprelda suhbatdan o'tgan va 6-aprelda yana intervyuga kelgan bo'lsa, uning birinchi intervyusi suhbatdan oldin va bu usul 6-apreldagisini ko'rmaydi.

> qat'iy shart bir kunda bo'lgan bosqichlarni tashlab yuboradi: 4-nomzod ariza bergan kuni suhbatdan o'tgan.

GROUP BY stage bilan bosqichlarni sanash qulay, lekin hech kim yetmagan bosqich natijadan yo'qoladi va qatorlar 4 tadan kam bo'ladi.

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da DATE - DATE butun son, kunlar soni. SQLite'da sanalar matn, ayirma julianday(b) - julianday(a) bilan olinadi:

Faqat SQLiteWITH a AS (
  SELECT candidate_id, MIN(happened_on) AS t
  FROM events
  WHERE stage = 'applied'
  GROUP BY candidate_id
),
s AS (
  SELECT a.candidate_id, MIN(e.happened_on) AS t, julianday(MIN(e.happened_on)) - julianday(a.t) AS d
  FROM a
  JOIN events e ON e.candidate_id = a.candidate_id AND e.stage = 'screen' AND e.happened_on >= a.t
  GROUP BY a.candidate_id, a.t
),
i AS (
  SELECT s.candidate_id, MIN(e.happened_on) AS t, julianday(MIN(e.happened_on)) - julianday(s.t) AS d
  FROM s
  JOIN events e ON e.candidate_id = s.candidate_id AND e.stage = 'interview' AND e.happened_on >= s.t
  GROUP BY s.candidate_id, s.t
),
o AS (
  SELECT i.candidate_id, MIN(e.happened_on) AS t, julianday(MIN(e.happened_on)) - julianday(i.t) AS d
  FROM i
  JOIN events e ON e.candidate_id = i.candidate_id AND e.stage = 'offer' AND e.happened_on >= i.t
  GROUP BY i.candidate_id, i.t
),
steps AS (
  SELECT 1 AS pos, 'applied' AS stage, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a) AS candidates, NULL AS avg_days
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'screen', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s), (SELECT ROUND(AVG(d), 1) FROM s)
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'interview', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM i), (SELECT ROUND(AVG(d), 1) FROM i)
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'offer', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM o), (SELECT ROUND(AVG(d), 1) FROM o)
)
SELECT stage, candidates, avg_days
FROM steps
ORDER BY pos
